meaning: Finite cycle-mean stationarity does not imply periodic waveform-envelope stationarity. A growing ripple with constant cycle mean passes the current mean-only screen. This does not invalidate source/provenance checks or historical raw reductions, but prevents treating that screen as complete thermal periodic-state convergence.
required_next: Separate versioned envelope guard and positive/growing-ripple controls, followed by actual final-tail replay before any new acceptance.
scope: Independent deterministic synthetic reducer execution only; no SPICE/native simulation, no original result or prior peer receipt changes.
